_doc: CHG-ESTACK-B7-SECURITY-COVERAGE-001 — lot B7: security coverage. Exposes 16 certified security queries rewritten so that nothing leaves the database unsanitized: CDB_* variants per container, aggregated counts instead of object lists, Oracle-maintained grantees excluded from 12.1.0.2, dates as hours, DB link host and keystore path never selected. Same rules as lots/B1-oracle-core.json.

collectors.title: Database accounts per container: status, profile, authentication type, common/Oracle-maintained flags and ages in hours (names masked; own or open accounts from 12.1.0.2)
Data Redaction policies counted by enabled state and redaction function (no owner, object, column or policy names)
Database Vault option and registry status (reading status is not using the option)
Oracle Label Security option status (reading status is not using the option)
Database links per container: masked owner and name, public or private, fixed or connected user, kind of target (host and username never leave the database)
TDE-encrypted columns counted per container, masked owner and algorithm (no table or column names)
Tablespaces per container encrypted or not, and the TDE algorithm (names masked)
Object privileges counted per grantee and privilege (masked grantee; Oracle-maintained grantees excluded from 12.1.0.2; no owners or objects)
Accounts counted per password verifier versions, container and Oracle-maintained flag (no user names, no verifiers)
Object privileges granted to PUBLIC, counted per privilege and owner (own schemas masked; Oracle schemas aggregated)
System privileges granted to PUBLIC per container
Roles granted to own users and roles per container: Oracle role by name or CUSTOM, admin option and default flag (grantees and own roles masked)
Roles counted per container, common and Oracle-maintained flags (no names)
Security-relevant initialization parameters: default flag and value only as number, TRUE/FALSE or closed keyword
System privileges granted directly to own users and roles per container (masked grantee; Oracle-maintained grantees excluded from 12.1.0.2)
TDE keystore per container: type, status, wallet type, order and backup flag (the keystore path never leaves the database)
